text: 100% of the shares of Adil Tasarruf Finansman A.Ş. (the İyi Finans brand's company) belong to Ali Emre Ballı, who is also its chairman, per the company's 2025 activity report.
short: Adil Tasarruf Finansman is 100% owned by Ali Emre Ballı

source.name: Milli Gazete: İyi Finans'ın sahibi kim, Ali Emre Ballı kimdir, şirketin yüzde 100 hissesi kime ait?
source.quote: Adil Tasarruf Finansman A.Ş.'nin yüzde 100 payı Ali Emre Ballı'ya ait.
source.note: Article also states Ballı is chairman and that the company was registered on 2 June 2025 with a BDDK operating licence of 7 July 2025.
